readableSrt.method: sentence then clause split at <=82 chars; timing proportional to character count inside each canonical cue window, with a 1.2 s minimum display per chunk redistributed inside the cue; concatenated text identical to canonical (whitespace-normalized); sequence kept monotonic across the one canonical overlap (cue 3/4) by a +0.336 s shift of cue 4 chunks
